title: Speaking — Making things
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on making things.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
Do you prefer to make something yourself or buy it?
What materials do you enjoy working with?

part2.topic: Describe an item you made that someone else used.
part2.closing: and explain what you learned from seeing another person use it.

questions: Why do some handmade objects keep their value over time?
What could schools do to make practical making accessible in crowded classrooms?
How has everyday life connected with making things changed for people of different ages?
